en_title: Xbox Reportedly Surveys Users On Return to Full Exclusivity for its Games
cn_title: 据称XBOX就恢复独占征询玩家意见
subtitle: 会为独占换主机吗
opus_summary: 据称XBOX通过问卷调查玩家对恢复主机独占的态度，设想除《使命召唤》外，旗下游戏仅登陆XBOX与PC。问卷还提出让《我的世界》在其他主机停售停更，是否落实尚不确定。

paragraphs.en: Xbox has reportedly surveyed players on how they would feel about a return to console exclusivity for all of its games, with the exception of Call of Duty.
paragraphs.cn: 据报道，XBOX向玩家发放了调查问卷，询问他们如何看待除《使命召唤》外的所有旗下游戏恢复主机独占。

paragraphs.en: The survey, first spotted and shared by Windows Central , asks fans multiple questions about exclusivity. Some of these questions ask about specific games, such as Fallout, being exclusive to Xbox consoles and PC, while one question asks fans to imagine a world where all Xbox titles, excluding Call of Duty, were made exclusive to Xbox and PC. Interestingly, one question also suggests removing Minecraft from sale on platforms like PlayStation and Nintendo, though players who already own the game could keep it. However, existing Minecraft games would not receive any further updates.
paragraphs.cn: 这份问卷最先由Windows Central发现并分享，其中向玩家提出了多个有关独占的问题。部分问题询问玩家如何看待《辐射》等特定游戏仅登陆XBOX主机和PC，另有一道题让玩家设想，除《使命召唤》外，所有XBOX游戏都由XBOX和PC独占。有意思的是，还有一道题提出，让《我的世界》在PlayStation和任天堂等平台停售，但已经拥有游戏的玩家可以保留游戏。不过，现有的《我的世界》游戏将不再获得任何更新。

paragraphs.en: "Imagine it was announced that all future title releases from every Xbox-developed gaming franchise except Call of Duty will be console-exclusive to Xbox," the question reads. "For Minecraft only, existing titles would no longer be available for purchase on PlayStation or Nintendo consoles, and would not receive any new content updates. However, there is no impact to any of the existing titles or content you already own. Nothing changes on PC in this announcement."
paragraphs.cn: 这道题写道：「请设想，XBOX宣布，除《使命召唤》外，所有由XBOX开发的游戏系列，其未来推出的作品都将在主机端由XBOX独占。仅针对《我的世界》，现有游戏将不再于PlayStation或任天堂主机上出售，也不会再获得任何新内容更新。不过，你已拥有的任何现有游戏或内容都不受影响。这项公告不会给PC端带来任何变化。」

paragraphs.en: The survey's questions are largely trying to see if fans really care about exclusivity, if they would switch hardware for it, or if they would skip a game because it was made exclusive. Whether this will actually amount to anything remains to be seen; companies consider a wide range of possibilities, regardless of how realistic they may be. However, all of this suggests that Xbox is at least considering on doubling down on exclusivity.
paragraphs.cn: 这份问卷主要想了解，玩家是否真的在意独占、是否会为独占更换硬件，以及是否会因为某款游戏成为独占而放弃游玩。这些调查究竟会不会带来实际行动，仍有待观察；公司会考虑各种可能性，无论这些设想是否切实可行。不过，这些问题表明，XBOX至少正在考虑加大对独占策略的投入。

paragraphs.en: Earlier this summer, Xbox announced that Gears of War: E-Day and Clockwork Revolution would be exclusive to Xbox and PC forever , but were hesitant to confirm exclusivity for other titles. Games like Forza Horizon 6 and Fable are still slated to come to PS5 , but it's unclear what will happen when something major like The Elder Scrolls 6 is released.
paragraphs.cn: 今年夏季早些时候，XBOX宣布《战争机器：事变日》和《发条革命》将永久由XBOX和PC独占，但不愿明确确认其他作品是否独占。《极限竞速：地平线6》和《神鬼寓言》等游戏仍计划登陆PS5，但《上古卷轴6》这样的大作推出时会采取何种策略，目前尚不清楚。

paragraphs.en: As of right now, we'll just have to wait and see what the future holds. Xbox is in a pretty critical spot right now, where it is trying desperately to salvage not only its reputation, but its financial viability after a tough generation. Xbox CEO Asha Sharma reportedly pointed the finger at Game Pass in a recent meeting , as players were no longer incentivized to purchase major releases like Call of Duty on day one.
paragraphs.cn: 目前，我们只能静观其变。XBOX正处于相当关键的关口，在经历了艰难的一个主机世代后，它正竭力挽回口碑，同时设法让业务在财务上维持下去。据报道，XBOX首席执行官Asha Sharma在最近的一次会议上将矛头指向了XBOX Game Pass，因为玩家已缺乏在首发当天购买《使命召唤》等大作的动力。

paragraphs.en: Xbox has spent this year walking back some of its previous plans by pulling Call of Duty from Game Pass on day one, and it's also rumored to be making some changes to day one offerings in 2027 . It'll be interesting to see where Sharma takes Xbox next, but it does appear that they're trying to see what fans want before making some big changes.
paragraphs.cn: 今年，XBOX撤回了部分先前的计划，包括取消《使命召唤》首发加入XBOX Game Pass的安排。另有传闻称，XBOX还会在2027年调整首发入库的游戏阵容。Sharma接下来会把XBOX带向何方，值得关注；不过，XBOX似乎正试图在作出重大改变前，先了解玩家的需求。
